scope: Opaque scalar/pointer/array members named unknown or unk plus an offset suffix in game struct/union definitions. Comments, literals, local variables and local SDK files are excluded. Other opaque naming, function-pointer declarations, raw offsets and ownership/callback evidence need separate audit; this is not completion proof. Inactive preprocessor branches are included. Initialized anonymous resources use their variable names as owners. Source-line movement does not invalidate a review; declaration changes require review. An entry establishes neither padding nor an allocation size.
